title: UNINVITED
start.tagline: You were fired. You were exiled. Now you are inside their network.
controls.title: Controls
controls: dash - hold to run (running is loud)
network vision - not for too long
routes: Pass unseen and hack your way through - or break everything and survive the waves.
pause.title: PAUSED
dead.title: SIGNAL LOST

won.quiet: Nobody saw you come or go.
toast.alarm1: ALARM 1 - DRONES ARE COMING TO LOOK
hint.start: Walk is quiet. Shift runs, and running is loud. C to crouch behind cover.
hint.camera: A camera. Crouch behind the blocks and move when the cone looks away.
hint.sensor: Hold Tab for network vision: hidden sensors blink. Walk past them - never run.
hint.niche: A niche: drones cannot get in, and crouched inside you are seen only up close.
hint.terminal: A terminal. E to hack it - you stand still while you work, and the security keeps moving.
hint.sound: A sound camera listens inside its ring. Crouch-walk or walk - do not run, jump or fight.
hint.redWall: A red wall. Find the terminal that controls it - or bring the whole alarm down on you.
